close_reason: pkits_helper.rs with pkits_cert/pkits_trust_anchor/pkits_validate; pkits_smoke.rs with 3 tests passing (4.1.1 valid, not-yet-valid, 4.1.2 root-only)
description:
Implement the test helper infrastructure in pkix-path/tests/ that all PKITS test cases will use.

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-6vd (fixtures must be committed first), PKIX-h6z (validate_path must work), PKIX-8wg (DefaultVerifier must exist).

Helpers needed:

pkits_cert(name: &str) -> Certificate
  Loads pkix-path/tests/pkits/certs/{name}.crt as DER and parses it.
  Panics with a clear message if the file is missing.

pkits_trust_anchor() -> TrustAnchor
  Loads TrustAnchorRootCertificate.crt and wraps it as a TrustAnchor.

pkits_validate(cert_names: &[&str], now_unix: u64) -> pkix_path::Result<ValidatedPath>
  Convenience: loads named certs in order (leaf first), builds the chain, calls validate_path with DefaultVerifier and the PKITS trust anchor.
  now_unix should be set to a fixed test time within the PKITS cert validity windows (check the actual cert dates from the fixtures).

assert_pkits_valid!(cert_names: [...])
assert_pkits_invalid!(cert_names: [...], Error::SomeVariant { .. })
  Test macros for readability.

The PKITS document numbers tests as e.g. '4.1.1' with cert names like 'ValidCertificatePathTest1EE', 'GoodCACert', etc. The helper should make it easy to write:
  assert_pkits_valid!(['ValidCertificatePathTest1EE', 'GoodCACert']);
title: PKITS: test helper infrastructure
